summary: Iteration 23 full-stack testing for SaaS Multi-tenant CRM Planos/Assinaturas + public booking with subscription credits + WhatsApp notify hook. rca of the issue: Two critical runtime ReferenceErrors in main agent's shipped code: (1) PlanosPageFull uses lucide icon <Tag/> in empty-state card but Tag was never added to the lucide-react import at top of SchedulingPages.js → ReferenceError crashed entire Planos route. (2) PublicBooking.js calls getServicePrice(svc) inside services.map() at line 197 but the helper was never defined in the component → ReferenceError crashed entire /boss/agenda public booking page. Root cause: missing final wire-up pass on imports and helpers when introducing new features (subscription pricing display on service list). Mitigation: I patched both — added Tag to the lucide import and added a getServicePrice helper that returns 0 when the active subscription covers the service with enough credits, else svc.price. Both pages now render successfully on retest.
